title: Megastore: Tidy Up Together
editorNote:
I’ve loved every minute with Megastore: Tidy Up Together, and I’m happy to say my experience was completely smooth — no bugs, no confusion, no mismatches at all. Every item lines up exactly with its shelf label; what you see is exactly where it goes. The scale is impressive too — from the cosy first store to the huge two-story Megastore, the variety never lets up. With over 1,350 unique products and a skill tree that lets you play your own way, it’s polished, reliable, and genuinely satisfying from start to finish.

Whether you want a quiet solo tidy-up or something to share with friends, I highly recommend this one. It delivers exactly what it promises — and it does it beautifully.

Have you played it? How did you find your favourite department? I’d love to hear your thoughts — feel free to share your experience in the comments below!
description: Megastore: Tidy Up Together is a cozy sorting game for solo or online co-op play. Organize four stores of increasing scale: a Toy Store, an Electronics Store, a bustling Supermarket, and a massive two-story Megastore. Pick up, sort, and shelve thousands of items, and get ready to open!

steps.title: Available Stores / Levels
steps.description:
The game currently features multiple stores that increase in size and difficulty:

📍Toy Store

•Smallest and easiest level.
•Great for learning the sorting mechanics.
•Mainly toys, pool items, and seasonal products.

📍Supermarket

•Larger store with many food and household products.
•Requires more careful organisation because of the variety of departments.
•A good step up in complexity from the Toy Store.

📍Megastore

•The biggest challenge.
•Features a huge number of products spread across multiple departments and floors.
•Best tackled with friends or by dividing sections into smaller tasks.

🖇️Note: A newer Electronics Store level has also been added, featuring thousands of electronic products and appliances.

steps.title: Quick Walkthrough
steps.description:
1. Learn the Layout

When entering a store, take a quick walk through each department. Shelf signs show where item categories belong.

2. Sort by Category First

Instead of placing items one at a time, gather similar products together. This makes shelving much faster.

3. Start with Large Sections

Clear big piles near department entrances first. You'll create more space to move around and spot item groups easier.

4. Use Teamwork

In multiplayer:

Assign players to different departments.
One player can sort while another shelves items.
Communicate where uncommon products belong.

5. Finish Shelf Organisation

After everything is placed, tidy shelves so matching products are grouped neatly together for maximum efficiency.

steps.title: Beginner Tips
steps.description:
•Don't worry about perfection at the start; focus on getting items into the correct department.
•Memorise common shelf locations to speed up future runs.
•Large stores become much easier when tackled section by section.
•Co-op significantly reduces completion time.

steps.title: Final Goal
steps.description: By correctly sorting and shelving every item, you'll transform a chaotic store into a clean, organised shopping space ready for customers. The challenge grows from the simple Toy Store, through the Supermarket, and finally the massive Megastore, making each level feel bigger and more rewarding than the last.
